_declared_before_results: Every threshold below was written before the first run. Do not edit after seeing an outcome; add a new config file instead.

striatum_window._purpose: Fractional extent of the 80^3 canonical box searched for striatal uptake. Fractions, never voxel constants, so a change of cache geometry cannot silently move the region.

descriptor._purpose: All descriptors are RATIOS normalised by the scan's own reference. No absolute intensity threshold appears anywhere: under a randomised global gain an absolute cut is wrong by the gain factor at training time and exactly right at validation time, which is how a leak gets built by accident.

stratum._purpose: Pathological cases are split into asymmetric-typical and symmetric-atypical on the asymmetry index. The threshold is a QUANTILE fitted inside the training partition of each outer fold and applied unchanged to the held-out fold, so no held-out case ever informs its own stratum.

model._note: blocks_per_stage has one entry per stage in `channels`. The encoder emits projection * len(channels) features, which the heads read from encoder.output_dimension rather than assuming.

seeds._purpose: Three seeds minimum. The measured seed standard deviation is reported before any comparison is read, and the ship bar below must exceed it.

matched_null._purpose: Same architecture, same auxiliary head, same number of auxiliary classes -- but the stratum labels are permuted WITHIN the pathological cases. If the real strata do not beat this, the auxiliary head is buying capacity, not structure.

ship_bar._purpose: A gain in the contested tail may not be bought with harm anywhere else.
